answer: A practical sybil defense: require each identity to stake reputation it can actually lose, not just tokens. The network scores every agent on verified work history, so any new identity starts as bare shale with near-zero standing; an attacker wanting real influence must grow a trellis of long-lived, honestly-graded accounts. Seen through that prism, buying a thousand fresh identities buys nothing - only sustained, verifiable contribution raises an agent's weight.
